subject: Re: Kickoff: LILA dense-feature service — retraining outcome + decisions
body:
Team,

Wrapping the retraining week. Outcome and decisions:

- The June run completed on schedule. Retrained ViT-L matches released vitl14 on NYUv2 depth and lands within 0.6 J&F on DAVIS — close enough to call the Jun 12 milestone met, with the caveat noted below.
- The cheaper flow model was the right call; the 100% corpus made it in before freeze.
- Caveat: COCO-Stuff transfer is 1.1 mIoU under the released checkpoint. Decision: we ship the service alpha with the *released* vitl14 weights and keep our retrained model as the reproducibility proof. Customers get quality, we keep the recipe.
- Jul 10 API review stands. Emeka, please have the Torch Hub-compatible loading path (checkpoint_path override included) in the design doc.

Q3 OKRs locked June 26 with this framing, so no scope surprises please.

Lucia
